# One player-visible portfolio-mode choice.  Modes A/B/C affect only the
# frozen background whitelist; mode D keeps the original 35-card route.
zg361p3.9000 = {
	type = character_event
	theme = stewardship
	title = zg361p3.9000.t
	desc = zg361p3.9000.desc
	trigger = {
		is_ai = no
		exists = scope:zg361_p3_aa_owner
		exists = scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject
		exists = scope:zg361_p3_aa_cycle
		exists = scope:zg361_p3_aa_case
		this = scope:zg361_p3_aa_owner
		scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_aa_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_aa_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_aa_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_aa_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_aa_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_aa_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = scope:zg361_p3_aa_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = scope:zg361_p3_aa_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = scope:zg361_p3_aa_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = 1
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zg361p3.9000.a
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_player_batch_mode value = 1 }
		scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject = { zg361_p3_aa_continue_player_effect = yes }
	}
	option = {
		name = zg361p3.9000.b
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_player_batch_mode value = 2 }
		scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject = { zg361_p3_aa_continue_player_effect = yes }
	}
	option = {
		name = zg361p3.9000.c
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_player_batch_mode value = 3 }
		scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject = { zg361_p3_aa_continue_player_effect = yes }
	}
	option = {
		name = zg361p3.9000.d
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_player_batch_mode value = 4 }
		scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject = { zg361_p3_aa_continue_player_effect = yes }
	}
}

			}
		}
		else = {

# #233 — Who May See the Dashboard?
zg361p3.233 = {
	type = character_event
	theme = stewardship
	title = zg361p3.233.t
	desc = zg361p3.233.desc
	trigger = {
		is_ai = no
		exists = scope:zg361_p3_aa_owner
		exists = scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject
		exists = scope:zg361_p3_aa_cycle

		scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_aa_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_aa_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_aa_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_aa_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_aa_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_aa_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = scope:zg361_p3_aa_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = scope:zg361_p3_aa_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = scope:zg361_p3_aa_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = 2
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zg361p3.233.a
		scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject = {
			zg361_p3_m233_route_a_effect = {
				TICKET_OWNER = scope:zg361_p3_aa_owner
				TICKET_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject
				TICKET_CYCLE = scope:zg361_p3_aa_cycle
				TICKET_CASE = scope:zg361_p3_aa_case
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject = { has_variable = zg361_p3_runtime_applied var:zg361_p3_runtime_applied = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = zg361_p3_player_batch_mode
					var:zg361_p3_player_batch_mode < 4
				}
				scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject = { zg361_p3_aa_continue_player_effect = yes }
			}
			else = {
				trigger_event = { id = zg361p3.234 days = 1 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			# A manual choice that fails its current tuple/resource guard returns to
			# this exact card on D+1; the chain never advances on a failed write.
			trigger_event = { id = zg361p3.233 days = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_player_batch_fallback_mid value = 233 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zg361p3.233.b
		scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject = {
			zg361_p3_m233_route_b_effect = {
				TICKET_OWNER = scope:zg361_p3_aa_owner
				TICKET_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject
				TICKET_CYCLE = scope:zg361_p3_aa_cycle
				TICKET_CASE = scope:zg361_p3_aa_case
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject = { has_variable = zg361_p3_runtime_applied var:zg361_p3_runtime_applied = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = zg361_p3_player_batch_mode
					var:zg361_p3_player_batch_mode < 4

		}
		else = {

			trigger_event = { id = zg361p3.233 days = 1 }

		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zg361p3.233.c
		custom_tooltip = zg361p3.233.c.tt
		scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject = {
			zg361_p3_m233_route_c_effect = {

				TICKET_CASE = scope:zg361_p3_aa_case

			limit = { scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject = { has_variable = zg361_p3_runtime_applied var:zg361_p3_runtime_applied = 1 } }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_player_policy_debt_disclosed_n add = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = zg361_p3_player_batch_mode

	title = zg361p3.301.t
	desc = zg361p3.301.desc
	trigger = {
		is_ai = no
		exists = scope:zg361_p3_ag_owner
		exists = scope:zg361_p3_ag_subject
		exists = scope:zg361_p3_ag_cycle
		exists = scope:zg361_p3_ag_case
		this = scope:zg361_p3_ag_owner
		scope:zg361_p3_ag_subject = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ag_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ag_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ag_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ag_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ag_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ag_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = scope:zg361_p3_ag_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_p3_ag_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = scope:zg361_p3_ag_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = scope:zg361_p3_ag_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = 1
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zg361p3.301.a
		scope:zg361_p3_ag_subject = {
			zg361_p3_m301_route_a_effect = {
				TICKET_OWNER = scope:zg361_p3_ag_owner
				TICKET_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_p3_ag_subject
				TICKET_CYCLE = scope:zg361_p3_ag_cycle
				TICKET_CASE = scope:zg361_p3_ag_case
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:zg361_p3_ag_subject = { has_variable = zg361_p3_runtime_applied var:zg361_p3_runtime_applied = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = zg361_p3_player_batch_mode
					var:zg361_p3_player_batch_mode < 4
				}
				scope:zg361_p3_ag_subject = { zg361_p3_ag_continue_player_effect = yes }
			}
			else = {
				trigger_event = { id = zg361p3.302 days = 1 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			# A manual choice that fails its current tuple/resource guard returns to
			# this exact card on D+1; the chain never advances on a failed write.
			trigger_event = { id = zg361p3.301 days = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_player_batch_fallback_mid value = 301 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zg361p3.301.b
		scope:zg361_p3_ag_subject = {
			zg361_p3_m301_route_b_effect = {
				TICKET_OWNER = scope:zg361_p3_ag_owner
				TICKET_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_p3_ag_subject
				TICKET_CYCLE = scope:zg361_p3_ag_cycle
				TICKET_CASE = scope:zg361_p3_ag_case
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:zg361_p3_ag_subject = { has_variable = zg361_p3_runtime_applied var:zg361_p3_runtime_applied = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = zg361_p3_player_batch_mode
					var:zg361_p3_player_batch_mode < 4
				}
				scope:zg361_p3_ag_subject = { zg361_p3_ag_continue_player_effect = yes }
			}
			else = {
				trigger_event = { id = zg361p3.302 days = 1 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			# A manual choice that fails its current tuple/resource guard returns to
			# this exact card on D+1; the chain never advances on a failed write.
			trigger_event = { id = zg361p3.301 days = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_player_batch_fallback_mid value = 301 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zg361p3.301.c
		custom_tooltip = zg361p3.301.c.tt
		scope:zg361_p3_ag_subject = {
			zg361_p3_m301_route_c_effect = {
				TICKET_OWNER = scope:zg361_p3_ag_owner
				TICKET_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_p3_ag_subject
				TICKET_CYCLE = scope:zg361_p3_ag_cycle
				TICKET_CASE = scope:zg361_p3_ag_case
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:zg361_p3_ag_subject = { has_variable = zg361_p3_runtime_applied var:zg361_p3_runtime_applied = 1 } }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_player_policy_debt_disclosed_n add = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = zg361_p3_player_batch_mode
					var:zg361_p3_player_batch_mode < 4
				}
				scope:zg361_p3_ag_subject = { zg361_p3_ag_continue_player_effect = yes }
			}
			else = {
				trigger_event = { id = zg361p3.302 days = 1 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			# A manual choice that fails its current tuple/resource guard returns to
			# this exact card on D+1; the chain never advances on a failed write.
			trigger_event = { id = zg361p3.301 days = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_player_batch_fallback_mid value = 301 }
		}
	}
}

							has_variable = zg361_p3_runtime_applied
							var:zg361_p3_runtime_applied = 1

					}
				}
			}

# Hidden D+1 edge: closed AA -> first AG case.
zg361p3.9001 = {
	type = character_event
	hidden = yes
	trigger = {
		exists = scope:zg361_p3_aa_owner
		exists = scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject
		exists = scope:zg361_p3_aa_cycle
		exists = scope:zg361_p3_aa_case
		this = scope:zg361_p3_aa_owner
		zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_review_serial
				has_variable = zg361_p3_manager_portfolio_cycle
			}
			var:zg361_p3_manager_portfolio_cycle = var:zg361_review_serial
		}
		trigger_else = { always = no }
		scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = zg361_case_aa_owner
					has_variable = zg361_case_aa_subject
					has_variable = zg361_case_aa_cycle_serial
					has_variable = zg361_case_aa_case_serial
					has_variable = zg361_case_aa_state
					has_variable = zg361_case_aa_active
					has_variable = zg361_p3_portfolio_owner
					has_variable = zg361_p3_portfolio_subject
					has_variable = zg361_p3_portfolio_cycle
					has_variable = zg361_p3_portfolio_result_owner
					has_variable = zg361_p3_portfolio_result_subject
					has_variable = zg361_p3_portfolio_result_cycle
					has_variable = zg361_p3_portfolio_result_case
					has_variable = zg361_p3_portfolio_result_state
					has_variable = zg361_p3_portfolio_opened_domain
					has_variable = zg361_p3_portfolio_closed
					has_variable = zg361_result_case_owner
					has_variable = zg361_result_cycle_serial
					has_variable = zg361_result_case_serial
					has_variable = zg361_result_case_state
				}
				var:zg361_case_aa_owner = scope:zg361_p3_aa_owner
				var:zg361_case_aa_subject = scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject
				var:zg361_case_aa_cycle_serial = scope:zg361_p3_aa_cycle
				var:zg361_case_aa_case_serial = scope:zg361_p3_aa_case
				var:zg361_case_aa_state = 7
				var:zg361_case_aa_active = 0
				var:zg361_p3_portfolio_owner = scope:zg361_p3_aa_owner
				var:zg361_p3_portfolio_subject = scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject
				var:zg361_p3_portfolio_cycle = root.var:zg361_review_serial
				var:zg361_p3_portfolio_result_owner = var:zg361_result_case_owner
				var:zg361_p3_portfolio_result_subject = scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject

				var:zg361_p3_portfolio_opened_domain = 1
				var:zg361_p3_portfolio_closed = 0
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
	}
	immediate = {
		scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_portfolio_opened_domain value = 2 }
			zg361_p3_ag_launch_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
